prompt: They keep restarting the server every morning, and the memory leak keeps coming back.
why: Restarting hides the symptom. Fixing the leak fixes the cause.
trap: It isn't a recent change; it's an unfixed cause.

prompt: Wrapping the crash in a try/catch hid the error but left the wrong total.
tells: hid the error but left the wrong total
why: Silencing an error isn't fixing it. Find why it happens.
trap: Bad input may be the cause, but the lesson is fixing it, not hiding it.

prompt: After fixing the bug, she adds a test so it can't quietly return.
tells: adds a test so it can't quietly return
why: A test guards the real fix.
trap: Reproducing came first; this keeps it fixed.

prompt: Asking 'why?' several times leads from the crash to a missing check on input.
why: Digging to the underlying cause is fixing the root cause.
trap: It isn't explaining code; it's asking why.

prompt: He added 'if id == 37 skip' instead of finding why record 37 breaks.
tells: instead of finding why record 37 breaks
why: Special cases patch the symptom. The cause is still there.
trap: The data may be odd, but the lesson is the patch.

prompt: Once she found the real cause, she fixed it in the two other places it was copied.
tells: the two other places it was copied
why: Fixing the cause means fixing it everywhere.
trap: It isn't narrowing; it's finishing the fix.
